chunks: The likeness of those who were charged with the Torah but did not observe it, is that of a donkey who carries a load of books. How wretched the semblance of the people who deny the words of God! God does not show the unjust people the way.

key_terms.التَّوْرَاةَ: The Torah, the holy book revealed to Prophet Musa (AS)

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the donkey carrying books metaphor in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a critique of the Jewish scholars of the time who memorized the Torah but neglected its core tenets, serving as a warning for all believers against mere intellectual accumulation without practical implementation. The imagery of the donkey emphasizes the futility of knowledge that does not transform the carrier's character or guide their actions, linking this state directly to divine guidance being withheld from the unjust.
